messages.text:
I can’t refund all three today: the shop’s records show two napkins received back, but not the third. Only received units can be refunded. Would you like to request a refund for the two received napkins, totaling BRL 182.00? (refund-policy/v2/return)

The discounted total is divided equally among identical items, rounded down to whole centavos. Any leftover centavos are assigned one at a time to the last units. Those shares stay fixed; your napkins each have BRL 91.00 allocated to them. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Any refund still needs your confirmation using the proposal card’s button and staff approval, so I can’t promise completion today. (refund-policy/v2/approval) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
